description: This file defines the MD5 class used for computing MD5 hashes within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for reading XLS files.

classes.name: MD5
classes.description: A class implementing MD5 hashing algorithm for processing data streams in XLS file reading.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 object and sets up the hash context.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hash context to initial MD5 state.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current hash context as a string.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds data to the hash context for incremental hashing.

methods.name: f
methods.description: MD5 auxiliary function F used in hashing rounds.

methods.name: g
methods.description: MD5 auxiliary function G used in hashing rounds.

methods.name: h
methods.description: MD5 auxiliary function H used in hashing rounds.

methods.name: i
methods.description: MD5 auxiliary function I used in hashing rounds.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs a single step in the MD5 transformation process.

methods.name: signedInt
methods.description: Converts a value to a signed integer, handling PHP's integer representation.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates bits of an integer to the left by a specified amount.
